title: 2-Ingredient Fusion Ice Cream 🍨🍓 healthy no-sugar #shorts

segments.moment_description: Bringing fresh fruit to the kitchen
Blending the frozen fruit into creamy ice cream
Scooping and plating the fusion ice cream
Enjoying the healthy fusion ice cream together

description:
Fusion Ice Cream 🍨🍓 — creamy homemade ice cream from just frozen fruit, blended till soft-serve smooth. No sugar, no machine, no cream — a guilt-free dessert in minutes.

What fruit combo should I try next? 👇 Drop it in the comments!

🌿 Made with frozen bananas and berries blended with a splash of yogurt — naturally sweet and healthy.

Did you know? Frozen ripe bananas blend into a texture exactly like soft-serve ice cream, which is why 'nice cream' needs no added sugar or cream at all.
